about: a Go module the human can read but not push to (gh: READ)

gaps.gates: Proteus derives no gate command: setup copies teams/templates/ci/proteus-gates.yml with its EDIT placeholders, and the scaffold ticket fills them from the AGENTS.md ## Learned gate line, which the bootstrap (a model) writes
gaps.routing: which team a work order goes to: the lead reads teams/ROUTING.md rows; no function maps a path to a team
gaps.marker: no in-repo marker makes a repo read-only for agents; the nearest signal Proteus recognises is gh's READ or TRIAGE permission (guest mode), and guest mode keeps Proteus's files out of the repo, not the agents' changes
gaps.setup: install.js --plugin-setup never asks gh for the permission or reads guest mode: on this READ repo it writes teams/ and .claude/settings.json into the checkout; only --project goes guest

model.edits: none: a fix goes upstream as an issue
